sloka: तान्महर्षिः प्रमुदितः पूजयामास धर्मवित् ।आस्यतामिति चोवाच स्वागतम् तु निवेद्य च ॥२-५६-१७॥
transliteration: tānmaharṣiḥ pramuditaḥ pūjayāmāsa dharmavit ।āsyatāmiti covāca svāgatam tu nivedya ca ॥2-56-17॥

translations.english: The great sage Valmiki conversant with righteousness was delighted. He honoured them by extending welcome and said 'Be seated'.
